claims.quote: The drone will enter a reconnection state when the C2 (Command & Control) link is lost, continuously attempting to re- establish connection with the ground control station (e.g., the remote controller).

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message 'Aircraft disconnected,' and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.

text: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link if possible, and discontinue flight or avoid further operations if the link cannot be reestablished. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: the drone enters a reconnection state and, if reconnected within 10 seconds, control returns automatically; if not, a warning is shown and a preset Signal Loss Action is executed, with RTH attempting to reconnect. Incident reports (unverified): claims of loss of control, continued flight away, failed Return To Home, and the UAS not being located. Gap/conflict: FAA favors discontinue or emergency procedures; Autel describes automatic signal-loss actions and possible continued RTH/hover behavior, with unclear verbatim transfer conditions and limited documented settings in the incident reports.
